content.short: A 6,666 PFP collectible project that brings our beloved pop culture vampires from fantasy worlds and victorian times into Cardano.
content.description:
PVC is the first 6,666 PFP collectible project that brings our beloved pop culture vampires from fantasy worlds, victorian times, all the way to cyberpunk dystopian futures directly into the Cardano blockchain in the form of a retro and pixel art non-fungible tokens. Because we believe community comes first, our goal is to build a friendly space were holders can receive all kinds of benefits, from exclusive animated airdrops to trade royalties.

We aim to expand the universe and bring new characters to life and have lots of surprises prepared. The vamp family always comes first and we feel that listening to our community is the true way to grow.
